title: How to Permanently Delete Your Instagram and Facebook Accounts (Step-by-Step)
excerpt: Meta has buried the account deletion option deep inside Accounts Center. Here is the step-by-step roadmap to purge your Instagram and Facebook data permanently without accidental reactivation.
description: Step-by-step guide to permanently deleting Facebook and Instagram accounts in 2026. How to backup photos, locate Accounts Center settings, and avoid the 30-day login trap.
metaTitle: How to Permanently Delete Instagram and Facebook (2026)
metaDescription: Easily navigate Meta Accounts Center to permanently delete your Instagram and Facebook profiles. Back up your media archives and prevent automatic reactivation.

faq.title: What is the difference between Deactivating and Deleting an account?
faq.description: Deactivation is temporary: your profile, photos, and comments become hidden from public view, but all your data remains stored on Meta's servers, and logging in at any time reactivates your account instantly. Deletion is permanent: your profile, followers, posts, DMs, and metadata are queued for irreversible erasure from Meta's databases.

faq.title: What happens if I accidentally open Instagram or Facebook during the 30-day period?
faq.description: Meta operates a mandatory 30-day grace period. If you log into your account—or if a connected app (like Spotify, Tinder, or a mobile game) logs in using 'Sign in with Facebook'—the deletion process is cancelled immediately, and your profile is fully restored. You must start the deletion process from scratch.

faq.title: Can I reuse my exact Instagram username if I change my mind later?
faq.description: Usually no. Once an account is permanently deleted and the 30-day window expires, the username is retired. Even if no one else claims it, Meta frequently locks deleted handles to prevent impersonation.

html:
Why Meta Makes Account Deletion Difficult

In the era of algorithmic feeds and targeted behavioral advertising, Meta's business model relies on maintaining active monthly user statistics. Consequently, the company has relocated the deletion buttons multiple times, embedding them within the convoluted Meta Accounts Center menu hierarchy.

If you have decided on a digital detox or want to terminate your social footprint, follow this exact procedure to ensure your account is erased rather than merely paused or deactivated.

Crucial Preparation: Download Your Life Archives First

Once deletion completes, your childhood photos, direct message histories, and tagged memories cannot be recovered. Request a complete data export before proceeding:

  1. Open the Instagram or Facebook mobile app.
  2. Navigate to Settings and privacy > Accounts Center.
  3. Tap Your information and permissions > Download your information.
  4. Select Download or transfer information and choose whether you want a full copy or specific media types (Stories, Posts, Messages).
  5. Select Date range: All time, format as HTML (for easy offline viewing in any web browser), and media quality to High.
  6. Confirm your request. You will receive an email within 24 to 48 hours containing secure download links for the zip archive.

Step-by-Step: Permanent Deletion in 2026

Once your zip archives are safely saved on your computer or external hard drive, follow these steps to trigger deletion:

  1. In Instagram or Facebook, open Settings and privacy > Accounts Center.
  2. Under Account settings, tap Personal details.
  3. Tap Account ownership and control.
  4. Tap Deactivation or deletion.
  5. Choose the specific profile you wish to delete (e.g., your Instagram handle or Facebook profile).
  6. Select the radio button marked Delete account: Deleting your account is permanent and tap Continue.
  7. Select any reason for leaving and tap Continue.
  8. Enter your account password to confirm identity, and click Delete Account.

Bypassing the 30-Day Cancellation Trap

Meta will inform you: 'Your account will be deleted on [Date 30 days from now].' During these 30 days, your profile is hidden from the public, but the deletion request is held in an active cancellation queue.

To prevent accidental cancellation:

  • Unlink Third-Party SSO Logins: If you use 'Log in with Facebook' on Spotify, Pinterest, or fitness trackers, change their login method to an email/password immediately. If any app pings Meta's API during the 30-day window, your account will be reactivated automatically.
  • Delete Saved Credentials: Remove your account from the Instagram app switcher and clear saved passwords from Apple Keychain or Google Password Manager.
  • Uninstall the App: Delete the app from your smartphone so you do not instinctively open it from muscle memory.

Complete Database Purge Timeline

While public access ends immediately and account recovery becomes impossible after 30 days, Meta's terms of service state that it may take up to 90 days from the date of the request to clear backup server tapes, log files, and analytical records across their global data centers.
